paper.central_claim: ReasoningBank distills generalizable reasoning strategies from an agent's self-judged successful and failed experiences into memory, retrieves them at test time and writes new learnings back, outperforming memory baselines that store raw trajectories or successful routines in effectiveness and efficiency; MaTTS (memory-aware test-time scaling) further amplifies gains through memory-scaling synergy.

signatures.object: ReasoningBank: JSON store of {task query, trajectory, <=3 memory items (title, description, content)} injected into the agent system prompt
signatures.information: Task query embedding (gemini-embedding-001), full trajectory, LLM-judge success/failure label (no ground truth); same backbone as extractor and judge
signatures.operation: Judge trajectory -> extract strategy items (success: validated strategies; failure: pitfalls/guardrails) -> append -> top-k (default 1) retrieval by cosine similarity
signatures.output: Memory items in the system instruction at each new task
signatures.conditions: Online stream; memory starts empty per run
signatures.feedback: LLM-as-a-judge binary outcome on the trajectory (72.7% accurate on Shopping)
signatures.selection_rule: None: every extracted item is appended without pruning
signatures.persistence: JSON file per independent run; embeddings in a second JSON
signatures.later_use: Retrieved for every subsequent query in the stream
signatures.claimed_effect: WebArena overall +8.3/+7.2/+4.6 over No Memory; SWE-Bench-V +4.6/+3.4; ~4% more tokens; fewer steps
signatures.failure_boundary: Judge noise (robust within 70-90% in simulation); more retrieved experiences hurts (k>1); no pruning so store unbounded

signatures.object: MaTTS: k parallel trajectories (self-contrast) or k sequential refinements per query used to curate memory
signatures.information: Multiple trajectories of the same query, retrieved memory, no external judge for the contrast step
signatures.operation: Parallel: compare/contrast trajectories to extract consistent patterns; sequential: self-refine and keep intermediate notes
signatures.output: Higher-quality items written to ReasoningBank; BoN or Pass@1 reported
signatures.feedback: Contrast among own rollouts; BoN chosen by an LLM
signatures.later_use: Memory guides scaled exploration for later queries
signatures.failure_boundary: Weaker memories gain little from scaling (Synapse 40.6->41.2); evidence from one subset/backbone

gap.author_gap: Agent memories store raw trajectories or only successful routines, so they lack higher-level transferable patterns and underuse failures.
gap.checked_gap: Supported against Synapse (trajectories) and AWM (success workflows), which are run; failure-learning reflective stores exist in related work but are not compared.
gap.lineage: Synapse (trajectory memory) -> AWM (workflow memory) -> ReasoningBank (strategy-level items from both outcomes) -> MaTTS (memory x test-time scaling).
closest_adjacent: Reflexion/ExpeL-style reflective memories (cited as related, not baselines)
gap.residue: Success-only extraction degrades or stagnates when failures are added (AWM 44.4 -> 42.2).
gap.stakes: Repeated errors and redundant exploration (up to 26.9% fewer steps on successes, Table 4).
gap.method_response: Distill strategy-level items from both outcomes and use contrast under scaling.
gap.remaining_gap: No memory maintenance, no gate against judged-wrong entries, no comparison to other failure-aware stores, no held-out stream.
unresolved: Whether failure-aware prior memories (not pinned locally) would match ReasoningBank under the same retrieval

claims.text: ReasoningBank outperforms memory-free agents and Synapse/AWM in effectiveness and efficiency across WebArena, Mind2Web and SWE-Bench-Verified.
claims.setting: 3 backbones; WebArena 684 tasks, Mind2Web 1341, SWE-V 500; temperature 0.7; streaming memory; single run
claims.baseline_control: No Memory, Synapse, AWM with identical retrieval/consolidation
claims.selection_vs_test: Memory built online from the evaluated stream; no separate held-out split
claims.result_denominator: WebArena overall +8.3/+7.2/+4.6 vs No Memory (+4.7/+6.2/+3.7 vs best baseline, our arithmetic); SWE +4.6/+3.4 (n=500); Mind2Web SR 3.3->4.8, 1.7->2.3, 1.0->1.6
claims.allowed_conclusion: Consistent gains of roughly 3-8 points on WebArena/SWE over no memory and 4-6 over best baseline, within a single-run, stream-evaluated protocol; Mind2Web SR gains are at noise-floor scale.

claims.text: Learning from failures is uniquely enabled by ReasoningBank.
claims.allowed_conclusion: Failure inclusion helped on one subset/backbone; no comparison with other failure-aware memories.

claims.text: Memory and test-time scaling are synergistic (MaTTS).
claims.baseline_control: MaTTS w/o memory, w/o aggregation (vanilla TTS), Synapse, AWM
claims.result_denominator: parallel 49.7 -> 55.1 vs w/o memory 39.0-42.2; vanilla TTS 52.4 at k=5
claims.allowed_conclusion: On one subset/backbone, memory-aware scaling beats memory-free and memory-unaware scaling at matched k; BoN selection is LLM-based.

assessment.evidence_level_note: Memory written from earlier queries is read by later queries and a same-agent No-Memory control exists on three benchmarks; the stream is prequential (each query scored before its own memory is written) but there is no frozen-memory held-out split.
assessment.strongest_supported_claim: Single-run, author-reported: strategy items distilled from LLM-judged successes and failures, appended and retrieved top-1, raise WebArena SR by +8.3/+7.2/+4.6 and SWE-Bench-Verified by +4.6/+3.4 over no memory and by ~4–6 over Synapse/AWM under identical retrieval/consolidation, at ~4% extra tokens; failure inclusion and MaTTS synergy shown on one subset/backbone. Not reproduced.
unresolved: Comparison with other strategy/failure-aware memories (cited, not run).
Unbounded append-only store; judged-wrong items admitted.

G.reason: Opus sides with son55. The limitation of raw-trajectory and success-only memories is specific and the two named neighbours are run, but the paper's own related work lists strategy/concept-level stores (opus:O03) and the Limitations concede no broader memory comparison (son55:E026), so the 'uniquely learns from failures' residue is not established against the nearest neighbours.

M.reason: Both seats 3; re-checked. Outcome-branched extraction, top-1 retrieval and MaTTS self-contrast make distinguishable predictions that are tested (extraction-only comparison, failure on/off, k sweep, memory-vs-no-memory scaling).

X.reason: Opus sides with son55. Retrieval/injection and append are stated, but consolidation is append-only with no gate, dedup, retirement or bound, judged-wrong items enter unchecked, query order and memory sharing across WebArena subsets are unspecified, and the extraction/judge prompts exist only as figure images (opus:O05); sol's 'prompt injection reconstructable' covers only the retrieval instruction.

E.measurement.reason: Both seats 3; re-checked. Official WebArena/SWE-Bench-Verified evaluators, standard Mind2Web metrics, measured judge accuracy (72.7%) and noise simulation; Mind2Web task SR sits near a 1–5% floor and BoN uses the backbone as selector.

E.causality.reason: Both seats 3; re-checked with added defects. No-Memory and extraction-only comparisons under identical retrieval/consolidation are strong controls; failure on/off and matched-k w/o-memory/w/o-aggregation scaling support the secondary claims. Weakening: ablations on one subset/backbone and text–number contradictions in the synergy argument (opus:O01, opus:O02).

E.holdout.reason: Both seats 2; re-checked. Label-free prequential streaming (each query answered before its memory is written) is declared, but there is no frozen held-out split, no overlap analysis, and k=1 was chosen on a reported subset.

E.statistics.reason: Both seats 1; re-checked (A2 rung 1). Subset sizes given, negative results reported (k>1 declines, AWM drop); single runs at temperature 0.7 with few-task differences (Multi n=29).

E.cost.reason: Opus sides with son55. Per-trajectory token breakdown including judge and extraction for the method and both memory baselines (+4.3% vs No Memory), step counts, and matched-k w/o-memory scaling controls; MaTTS k-fold rollout cost is only implicit (opus:O04) and Table 5's setting is unstated, which keeps it below 4.
